svg.title: AstralBeam wordmark for dark backgrounds
svg.desc: Geometric uppercase AstralBeam wordmark in the dark theme foreground and primary colors on a transparent canvas.
svg.metadata: AstralBeam dark wordmark construction: - Provenance: deterministic vector geometry redrawn from the supplied raster reference. - Reusable id: #astralbeam-wordmark. - Canvas: 1241 x 136 around a 1205 x 100 measured letter grid. - Padding: 18 units on every side, matching the median gap between adjacent letters. - Shared weight: every letter uses a nominal 14-unit stroke on the 100-unit cap height. - ASTRAL uses round caps and joins. BEAM uses square terminals, mitered corners, an open-left three-stroke B, a crossbarless A, and a geometric valley-centered M. - Palette source: apps/webapp/src/brand/colors.css .dark. - Embedded sRGB paints match the semantic tokens so this standalone SVG has no runtime CSS dependency.
